ns2:course.label: Directed Research
ns2:course.description: Nature and scope of projects to be determined by consultation between student and faculty adviser; open to landscape architecture majors as well as those from other disciplines who wish to engage in interdisciplinary work. Approved for both letter and S/U grading. May be repeated. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
